scripts.//dev: Builds the workspace packages FIRST, on purpose. `@grokbot2/proto` and `@grokbot2/pool-client` resolve to their dist/, so editing their src has no effect until they are rebuilt — and `tsx watch` hides that completely: it reloads this backend and keeps serving the stale build. That cost a wrong diagnosis (see the retraction in git log): we minted a random gateway token, checked against it, and handed the app a hardcoded literal from a day-old dist, then blamed the app for not re-fetching.
